rewrites.//: A specialist has a URL, and the cockpit reads the id back out of the path. Static hosting has to be told that /s/<id> is the same document.

headers.//: None of these carry a content hash in their name, so a cached copy is a cockpit that cannot be updated. They are a few kilobytes over a CDN; revalidating each load costs nothing worth keeping.
The mark changes about once a year.
